subject: Proration breakdown for June seat add - Stellarity
body:
From: Ariel Summers <ariel@stellarity.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Proration breakdown for June seat add - Stellarity

Hi Grace / Marissa,

We added 15 additional seats to our account on 2026-06-16 (license portal shows effective date 2026-06-16 10:22 UTC). Our billing contact is asking how that will be handled on the June invoice — will we see a separate prorated charge/line item for the mid-month top-up, or will you credit/offset it on the July invoice? Also: Stellarity is EU-registered (VAT ID: EU123456789) — can you confirm whether VAT will be applied or whether reverse-charge will be used?

We need the breakdown by line (seat qty, per-seat monthly rate, days prorated, tax treatment) so procurement can approve the payment.

Thanks,
Ariel Summers
Head of Platform Ops
Stellarity

---

On Tue, 30 Jun 2026 at 10:04 Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Summers <ariel@stellarity.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proration breakdown for June seat add - Stellarity

Hi Ariel — thanks for the heads up and for including the VAT ID. Short answer: you will see a prorated line on the June invoice for the added seats; depending on the VAT ID validation we will either apply reverse-charge (no VAT) or include VAT by statutory rate. Im looping in finance to confirm the exact net amount and to attach the provisional invoice.

Quick summary for procurement to review:
- Existing seats on 2026-06-01: 40
- Added on 2026-06-16: +15 seats
- Per-seat list price: 150.00 EUR / seat / month
- Proration window: 2026-06-16 (inclusive)  2026-06-30 (15 days out of 30)

Prorated calculation (gross, before VAT treatment):
15 seats * 150.00 EUR * (15/30) = 1,125.00 EUR

I will confirm whether we apply reverse-charge for your VAT ID and send an updated invoice (PDF) and a CSV schedule that shows the daily proration if procurement needs that level of detail.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

Michael — forwarding Ariel's note. Can you please: 1) confirm VAT treatment for EU ID EU123456789 (Stellarity), 2) confirm that June's invoice will include a prorated line for the 15-seat top-up (invoice #4527 provisional), and 3) if possible attach the PDF we will send to the customer and the CSV proration schedule. Procurement asked for the invoice this morning and wed like to close payment within 7 days.

Quoted message below for context.

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proration breakdown for June seat add - Stellarity

Thanks for the ping — I checked taxtools and the VAT ID EU123456789 validates for reverse-charge in our system (customer EU business, provided valid VAT). We will therefore issue the June invoice without VAT and include the standard reverse-charge note: "VAT reverse-charged to the customer under Article 196 of the EU VAT Directive; customer liable for local VAT."

Ive prepared (attached) a provisional invoice PDF that includes the prorated line item and a CSV that breaks the days out for your records. Summary numbers below (invoice net lines, EUR):
- Prorated seat top-up (15 seats, 15/30 days): 1,125.00 EUR
- Existing monthly subscription (40 seats): 6,000.00 EUR
- Invoice total (net, no VAT due to reverse-charge): 7,125.00 EUR

We can either:
A) Post the prorated charge on the June invoice (invoice #4527) and charge the payment method on file; or
B) Send the PDF as an invoice and provide a pay-by-link if procurement wants to use a different payment method.

Let me know which option Ariel prefers. Ive attached: Stellarity_Invoice_4527_2026-06-30.pdf and seat_change_proration_schedule_2026-06.csv (CSV shows per-day seat counts and per-day charge).

-Michael Grant
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Stellarity_Invoice_4527_2026-06-30.pdf (invoice PDF, net amounts shown; reverse-charge note included)
- seat_change_proration_schedule_2026-06.csv (CSV, 2 columns: date, daily_charge_eur)

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Summers <ariel@stellarity.ai>, procurement@stellarity.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proration breakdown for June seat add - Stellarity

Hi Ariel — thanks for the quick turnaround, Michael.

Stellarity: we will post the prorated charge on June invoice #4527 and charge the card on file unless you instruct otherwise. Summary and next steps: 

- Net charge (prorated top-up): 1,125.00 EUR
- Existing subscription (June): 6,000.00 EUR
- Invoice total (net): 7,125.00 EUR
- VAT: reverse-charge applied per validated VAT ID (EU123456789). No VAT amount is charged on the invoice; please self-account per local rules.
- Attachments: the provisional invoice PDF and CSV proration schedule are attached.

If procurement needs a pay-by-link instead of using the card on file, reply and well generate one and re-issue the invoice. Otherwise, expect the payment capture to go through within 72 hours of invoice issue.

Would you like me to confirm once the payment posts?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
